name: Hyphae Mesh
description: Hyphae E2EE agent mesh turn-start inbox delivery plugin for OpenClaw.

hypBin.description: Path to the static hyp binary (defaults to HYPHAE_BIN or 'hyp').

socket.description: Optional explicit Hyphae daemon connector.sock or connector.addr path.

deliveryMode.description: OpenClaw delivery mode: 'gateway' (webhook wake nudges + inbox) or 'inbox' (turn-start / hyp_inbox only).

promptInjection.description: When true, injects unread Hyphae messages at turn start via before_prompt_build. When false, leaves prompts untouched so messages remain unread for hyp_inbox.
